text: Some thinking it fit that Pyrrhus should banish a certain ill-tongued fellow in Ambracia, who had spoken very indecently of him, "Let him rather," said he, "speak against us here to a few, than rambling about to a great many."
author: Plutarch
speaker: Pyrrhus
translation: John Dryden et al., rev. Arthur Hugh Clough, 1864
